item.title: Patty's Bakery Fire, Drug Bust, Travis Johnson Memorial
item.ns0:title: Patty's Bakery Fire, Drug Bust, Travis Johnson Memorial
item.description:
Tonight on Our News Weekend, a devastating fire leaves a beloved community staple in ruins, but the owners of Original Patty's Bakery vow to reopen almost immediately. We take you to the crime beat where a high-stakes joint operation in Exuma leads to a massive million-dollar drug bust. Our team also joins family and friends gathered to celebrate the vibrant life of a beloved entertainer lost in the tragic North Andros plane crash, while a local church honors the quiet heroes making a difference in our communities. Plus, we highlight young Bahamian musicians taking center stage in Nassau and bring you the complete sports weekend report as our national swimmers secure another historic victory.
-----
